text.EN: Good. Keep moving before they bunch up.
text.TL: Ayos. Gumalaw tayo bago sila dumami.

text.EN: Clean hit. Don't let them gather.
text.TL: Malinis na tama. Huwag silang hayaang magtipon.

text.EN: Downed. Advance before they form a crowd.
text.TL: Bagsak na. Sulong bago maging kuyog.

text.EN: Handled. Push through before more arrive.
text.TL: Naasikaso. Lusot bago may dumating pa.

text.EN: Threat dead. Keep moving through the area.
text.TL: Patay ang banta. Tuloy sa paggalaw sa lugar.

text.EN: Solid kill. Advance while the lane is open.
text.TL: Solidong patay. Abante habang bukas ang daan.

text.EN: Target down. Move before the swarm groups.
text.TL: Target bagsak na. Kilos bago magsama-sama ang iba.

text.EN: Down. Keep momentum before reinforcements come.
text.TL: Bagsak. Panatilihin ang bwelo bago may sumaklolo.
Malinis na trabaho. Huwag maging nakatigil.
